about: Movie and series servers, best picture and sound first, measured from Kenya on 2026-10-22 on Matlock (2024) S1E1, S2E1, S2E16 and Dune: Part Two. No working server offered more than 1080p (Dune: Part Two exists in 4K; none served it above 1080p). The app offers them in this order, leaving out any marked down by the daily check (scripts/server-health.mjs) or failing for viewers (play_proof).

servers.name: VidZee · 1080p · 5.1
servers.note: Matlock S1E1, S2E1, S2E16 at 1920x1080 with 5.1 surround (6-channel AAC); Dune: Part Two at 1080p. Fixed 1080p: never drops on a slow start. Reports its clock, so the next episode starts by itself.

servers.name: VidRock · 1080p · Dolby 5.1
servers.note: Dune: Part Two at 1080p with Dolby Digital Plus 5.1 (E-AC-3); Matlock episodes at 1080p with stereo AAC (the sound follows each title's source). Played all three Matlock episodes, slow to start (up to ~20 s).

servers.name: Viduki · 1080p
servers.note: Serves the same stream as VidZee, through a different front end: a backup for when VidZee's own player is down. Sound not measured separately.

servers.name: VidLink Pro · 1080p
servers.note: Played Matlock S2E16 (starts at 480p; the app's HD setting lifts it). Did not have Dune: Part Two ("We couldn't find this content"). Stereo.
